chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Hanan ibn Sadir, from his father, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Among the things that are conducive to good for the Muslim man is that he has a wife who, when he looks at her, she delights him; when he is absent from her, she preserves his interests; and when he gives her an instruction, she obeys him.'

key_terms.أَطَاعَتْهُ: She obeyed him — responding to lawful instructions within the marital relationship
key_terms.الْقِسْمُ الْمُصْلِحُ: The beneficial portion/share — that which is divinely apportioned to improve one's condition
key_terms.حَفِظَتْهُ: She preserved/guarded him — protecting his honor, wealth, and household in his absence
key_terms.سَرَّتْهُ: She delighted/gladdened him — bringing visual and emotional satisfaction

ai.seo_question: What are the qualities of an ideal wife according to the Prophet Muhammad in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) transmits a hadith from the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) describing the qualities of an ideal wife. The Prophet identifies three hallmarks of a righteous wife: she brings joy to her husband when seen, she safeguards his interests and honor in his absence, and she obeys him when he gives instructions. This hadith appears in the chapter on the merits of a compatible righteous wife and reflects the Quranic ideal of the salihah (righteous woman) found in Surah al-Nisa' (4:34).
word_analysis: that which is conducive to good/beneficial
